stories.story_fr: Les commandes ont progressé de 10 % au premier trimestre 2026, atteignant 21,4 milliards d’euros.
stories.story_en: Orders grew 10 % in Q1 2026, reaching €21.4 billion.
stories.quote: Orders in Q1 2026 were up 10 percent on a comparable basis to €21.4 billion

stories.story_fr: Le flux de trésorerie disponible est tombé à 0,7 milliard d’euros au T1 2026 après 5,3 milliards au T4 2025.
stories.story_en: Free cash flow fell to €0.7 billion in Q1 2026 after €5.3 billion in Q4 2025.
stories.quote: Free cash flow at Group level was €0.7 billion

stories.story_fr: Le profit du Business Industriel a atteint 2,9 milliards d’euros, en hausse de 15 % au premier trimestre 2026.
stories.story_en: Industrial Business profit reached €2.9 billion, up 15 % in Q1 2026.
stories.quote: Profit Industrial Business increased 15 percent to €2.9 billion

stories.story_fr: Le ratio commande‑facture s’est amélioré à 1,12 au T1 2026, contre 1,02 au T4 2025.
stories.story_en: The book‑to‑bill ratio improved to 1.12 in Q1 2026 from 1.02 in Q4 2025.

stories.story_fr: Siemens a relevé ses prévisions d’EPS de base pour l’exercice 2026.
stories.story_en: Siemens raised its outlook for basic EPS for fiscal 2026.
stories.quote: we raise its outlook for basic EPS from net income before purchase price allocation accounting (EPS pre PPA) from a range of €10.40‑€11.00 to a range of €10.70‑€11.10 for fiscal 2026
